title: Reshooting piece by piece
description: The parts that worked stay, and a slip can be replaced with a separate take.

blocks.text: A mistake at the end of a long text should not wipe out the beginning. But a set of separate clips still has to be assembled into coherent speech.

quote.text: When trying to record videos and start at a new point within the script, the script jumps way far ahead and you can’t back up. It takes me hours to record a five minute script because I keep having to start over.

blocks.text: Split the script into points to return to, keep the variants and show the chosen takes in sequence. Leave a small margin for the join.
Check the transitions, the sound and the speaker’s position. Automatic stitching does not guarantee a natural result without watching it.
